description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok e-Commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-Commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:

Seller Growth & Engagement


 Support the execution of seller growth programs such as webinars, educational sessions, and platform campaigns while assisting Category and Operations teams in promoting key initiatives including campaigns, LIVE activities, and promotional events.
 Help drive seller participation in platform programs, campaigns, and content initiatives and monitor seller feedback to help identify opportunities to improve engagement.


Content & Communication


 Support the creation and coordination of seller-facing communications across email, social channels, webinars, and community groups to help ensure communications are clear, accurate, and aligned with platform guidelines.
 Coordinate with internal teams to gather information and assets for seller communications, and assist in maintaining communication calendars and campaign materials organized and updated


Campaign & Project Management


 Support cross-functional seller marketing projects by coordinating with teams such as Content, LIVE, Product, Legal, and Operations.
 Track timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups to help ensure smooth execution and assist with campaign setup, reporting, and operational tasks.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or Communications
 Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 Strong interest in e-commerce, creator economy, digital marketing, and marketplace platforms.
 Analytical mindset with basic knowledge of data analysis and reporting.


Preferred Qualification


 Previous internship or extracurricular experience in marketing, e-commerce, digital content, operations, or project coordination is a plus.


By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

E-Commerce Marketing Specialist (TikTok Shop focused)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary: $1200 to $1800 USD/month based on experience + profit sharing bonuses based on performance.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




The Role

We are looking for a Marketing Specialist who can help make TikTok Shop a major growth engine for TopFoxx while supporting broader marketing, creative, influencer, and conversion initiatives.




This is not a traditional marketing manager role. You do not need prior TikTok Shop experience. You need to be a strong marketer who understands short-form content and learns platforms quickly. We are looking for someone who executes and brings results. You should be able to receive a problem like: "TikTok Shop isn't performing the way it should. Figure out what's happening."… and independently investigate the data, identify the problems, develop a strategy, start implementing solutions, monitor the results, and continue improving.




You will work across TikTok Shop, creators, influencer marketing, creative strategy, paid media, website conversion, and e-commerce marketing. You do not need to be the world's best expert in every area. But you need to be curious, capable, hands-on, and willing to figure things out.




What Success Looks Like

Grow TikTok Shop revenue and conversion while using creators, content, creative strategy, and broader marketing opportunities to drive measurable e-commerce growth.




You will be responsible for:

Understand → Identify → Strategize → Execute → Measure → Optimize → Scale




We want someone who can connect the dots between what customers see, what creators produce, how products are presented, and what ultimately makes someone buy.

Two numbers define this role. We get about 2,000 affiliate videos a month from roughly 650 creators, and only 1 to 2% of them drive any sales. Your job is to get us to 5,000 affiliates posting every month, and to take that 1 to 2% up to 5%. Volume alone would roughly triple this channel. Volume plus quality takes it about seven times where it is today.

And it has to be profitable. Every TikTok Shop sale carries a referral fee, affiliate commission, ad spend, discounts and shipping on top of product cost, so a campaign that looks like it is winning on reported ROI can still be losing us money. Growing revenue while margin disappears is not success here.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) TikTok Shop Growth (Primary Focus)

Understand the current state of our TikTok Shop and identify areas of opportunity.
Analyze GMV, sales, conversion, traffic, product performance, and creator-generated revenue.
Identify why products, content, or campaigns are underperforming.
Find opportunities to increase daily sales and overall GMV.
Develop and execute TikTok Shop growth strategies.
Test products, content, offers, campaigns, and creator strategies.
Follow TikTok Shop updates daily and be first to test them. New features are worth the most before the rest of the market catches on. 
Identify TikTok Shop features and opportunities TopFoxx is not currently utilizing.
Monitor performance and adjust strategies based on results.
Stay up to date, daily, on TikTok Shop updates, trends, tools, and best practices.
Build repeatable processes that make TikTok Shop growth more scalable.




2) Affiliate, Creator & Influencer Marketing 

Grow our affiliate base to 5,000+ creators posting every month, and lift the share of affiliate videos that actually drive sales from 1 to 2% up to 5%. Both numbers have to move together. More videos at the same quality is not the goal.
Build strong relationships with our top revenue-generating creators on TikTok Shop and win over the biggest GMV creators in our category. Keep a tracked written record of every conversation with each one, so the relationship lives in the company and not in one person's inbox.
Communicate directly with TikTok Shop creators and influencers.
Build relationships with high-potential creators.
Identify creators who have the ability to generate sales.
Identify which creators and content should be scaled.
Create clear creator briefs and content direction.
Give creators feedback on hooks, messaging, products, and content structure.
Help negotiate additional content or compensation when appropriate.
Develop creator campaigns around products, launches, promotions, and seasonal opportunities.
Identify opportunities for TikTok LIVE and other creator-led selling initiatives.
Connect creator performance back to GMV, conversion, and overall business results.




3) Creative Strategy

Review TikTok, Instagram, and paid creative.
Identify why certain videos capture attention and others do not.
Develop hooks, angles, concepts, and messaging.
Create content briefs for creators and internal teams.
Give actionable feedback on videos and creative.
Identify customer pain points that can become content opportunities.
Turn product benefits, reviews, objections, and customer questions into creative concepts.
Develop TikTok and Instagram content strategies.
Identify winning creator content that could be replicated or expanded.
Help determine which creative should be scaled.
Connect organic content, creator content, and paid advertising.
Build repeatable creative frameworks and testing processes.




4) Creative Execution

We want a marketer who can actually execute. You do not need to be an expert designer or professional video editor. However, you should have enough hands-on creative ability to make or modify content when necessary rather than being completely dependent on another person.




Experience with tools such as: Photoshop, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Other video or creative production tools is valuable.




You may:

Make simple creative edits.
Modify images or graphics.
Edit short-form video.
Create basic social content.
Build simple creative variations.
Add text, captions, hooks, or CTAs to content.
Prepare creator briefs and visual references.
Create basic marketing assets when needed.




5) Conversion & E-Commerce Optimization

Review product pages and landing pages.
Identify conversion friction and customer objections.
Evaluate whether advertising and product-page messaging are aligned.
Recommend improvements to product positioning and messaging.
Review product images, videos, headlines, descriptions, and calls to action.
Recommend creative improvements for website pages.
Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from content → product page → purchase.
Help develop conversion-focused landing page concepts.
Review Amazon product creative and content.
Evaluate TikTok Shop product presentation and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
Use customer questions, reviews, comments, and behavior to identify conversion opportunities.




6) Paid Media & Creative Support

Review existing paid advertisements.
Evaluate hooks, messaging, creative angles, and offers.
Identify opportunities to repurpose successful organic or creator content into paid ads.
Recommend creative concepts for Meta and TikTok.
Provide feedback on paid creative.
Help identify winning creative that should be scaled.
Connect paid media insights back to TikTok Shop and influencer strategies.
Help develop creative testing ideas.
Analyze creative performance and recommend improvements.




7) Data, KPIs & Performance

You will use data to make decisions, but this is not a purely analytical role.
You should be comfortable tracking and interpreting metrics such as: GMV, Revenue, Conversion rate, Orders, Traffic, Average order value, Creator-generated revenue, Creator posting frequency, Content performance, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, Video retention, Engagement, Product-level conversion, 
The goal is always to connect the numbers to action.




8) Testing & Growth Initiatives

Test new TikTok Shop strategies.
Test creator approaches.
Test content angles and hooks.
Test offers and promotions.
Test product positioning.
Test creative formats.
Identify new platform opportunities.
Research competitors and market trends.
Look for new ways to increase conversion.
Stop strategies that are not producing results and quickly move toward better opportunities.




What We're Looking For




Must-haves:

2+ years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, TikTok Shop, influencer marketing, growth marketing, or a related field.
Strong understanding of short-form content and social media marketing.
Ability to analyze performance data and turn it into actionable decisions.
Strong marketing judgment and understanding of customer psychology.
Ability to work independently without constant direction.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.
Margin literacy. You understand that reported ROI is not profit, and you can reason through commissions, referral fees, discounts, shipping and product cost to figure out whether something actually made money. 




Nice to have:

Experience growing TikTok Shop Seller Center, Shopify, Amazon, Meta Ads or TikTok Ads.
Experience with landing pages and CRO.
Experience creating or editing short-form video.
Photoshop, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar creative tools.
DTC or consumer brand experience.




What You Get:

$1200 - $1800 USD/month, based on experience and demonstrated ability.
Performance-based bonuses tied to measurable results.
Fully remote role with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.
Direct collaboration with leadership and the Founder.
High ownership over one of TopFoxx's key growth channels.
Opportunity to make a measurable impact on a growing DTC brand.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off and company holidays.
Long-term growth opportunity as the TikTok Shop channel expands.

About the job

Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

The AI Web Optimization Specialist is responsible for improving how Forcepoint.com attracts, engages and converts prospective buyers through the strategic application of artificial intelligence, behavioral analytics, experimentation and personalization.

This role will analyze how visitors interact with the website, identify areas of friction or opportunity and translate those findings into measurable improvements across content, navigation, conversion paths, forms and personalized experiences. The specialist will also develop AI-assisted workflows that help the web team analyze performance, generate hypotheses, evaluate content and accelerate optimization.

Working across Web Strategy, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, UX and Development, this role will help us transform Forcepoint.com to a more intelligent, adaptive and consistently measured digital experience.

The role supports the entire digital buyer journey, from discovery and education through product evaluation and conversion. It will also help ensure that Forcepoint’s web content and technical foundations are understandable to AI-powered search engines, assistants and answer platforms.

About the job

Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,200 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.




The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:




80% Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

Your primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.




20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business Support

We're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.




Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.




We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.

title: Sales and Leasing Specialist
description:
About the job

About the Role




We're looking for a high-energy, results-driven Sales and Leasing Specialist to serve as the

critical first point of contact for every prospective resident who shows interest in our properties.

This is a fast-paced, hybrid position where speed, warmth, and persistence directly translate to

occupancy success. Your mission is simple but vital: connect with every lead within one hour,

convert interest into scheduled property tours, and guide qualified prospects through the

application process to move-in.




This role is perfect for someone who thrives on call volume, loves the challenge of winning

people over, takes pride in flawless execution of a proven system, and has the organizational

discipline to manage multiple prospects through various stages of the leasing journey.




What You'll Do: 




Speed to Lead Execution

• Monitor the CRM continuously throughout your shift for incoming leads across all

properties

• Contact every new lead within 5 minutes via phone (primary) and follow-up

communication

• Make multiple contact attempts using strategic timing and persistence until you reach the

prospect




Tour Conversion & Sales

• Engage prospects with warmth and professionalism, building rapport quickly over the

phone

• Qualify leads, understand their needs and timeline, and match them to the right property

• Overcome objections and address concerns to move prospects toward booking a tour

• Schedule tours and confirm appointments, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks

• Follow up with prospects who haven't responded or are "thinking about it"




Application Management & Administrative Support

• Guide qualified prospects through the application process, ensuring they understand

requirements and timelines

• Proactively follow up with applicants to collect outstanding documents (pay stubs, IDs,

references, etc.)

• Review submitted applications for completeness and accuracy before routing for

approval

• Communicate application status updates to prospects, keeping them informed and

engaged throughout the process

• Coordinate with the property team to resolve application questions and move approved

applicants toward lease signing

• Maintain organized tracking of all prospects in the pipeline—from initial contact through

move-in




CRM Management & Documentation

• Log all call activity, prospect details, objections, and outcomes in the CRM accurately

and immediately

• Update lead status and next steps to ensure seamless handoff to the touring team and

property managers

• Track your own metrics: contact rate, conversion rate, tours booked, applications

submitted, and speed to lead performance




Accountability & Optimization

• Own your daily and weekly goals for calls made, contacts reached, tours booked, and

applications completed

• Identify patterns in objections, application drop-offs, or process bottlenecks and

proactively suggest improvements

• Maintain high energy and quality standards even during high-volume periods




What We're Looking For: 

Required Skills & Traits

• Exceptional Phone Presence – You sound confident, friendly, and genuine. People

want to talk to you even when they didn't plan to.

• Natural Sales Ability – You know how to listen, ask the right questions, create urgency,

and close without being pushy.

• Self-Starter Mentality – You don't need someone looking over your shoulder. You see a

lead, you call it. You see a problem, you solve it.

• Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented – You're tracking dozens of leads and applications

at different stages and nothing slips through the cracks. You thrive on systems, follow-

through, and keeping meticulous records.

• Strong Administrative Skills – You can manage paperwork, chase down missing

documents, and keep multiple applicants moving forward without dropping the ball. You

understand that administrative excellence is what turns tours into move-ins.

• Resilient & Consistent – Rejection doesn't faze you. You understand that 50 calls

might lead to 10 conversations and 3 tours, and you're energized by that reality, not

discouraged.

• Process-Driven – You understand that accurate CRM data and complete applications

aren't busywork—they're what allows the team to win.

• Comfortable with Repetition – You're calling leads and following up on applications all

day. If you need constant variety, this isn't the role for you. If you love perfecting a craft

through repetition, you'll excel here.

Preferred Experience

• 1-2+ years in inside sales, appointment setting, leasing, or customer service roles

(property management experience is a plus but not required)

• Experience working in a CRM system (Yardi, Knock, Rent Manager, Salesforce, or

similar)

• Proven track record of hitting or exceeding call/conversion metrics

• Experience managing application processes, collecting documents, or similar

administrative workflows

• Experience in a hybrid or virtual work environment




What Success Looks Like

Within 30 days, you're:

• Consistently contacting 90%+ of leads within 60 minutes

• Booking 15-20+ tours per week

• Maintaining accurate CRM records with zero missed follow-ups

• Successfully guiding applicants through document submission with minimal hand-

holding from managers




Within 90 days, you're:

• A trusted subject matter expert on objection handling and lead conversion

• Hitting or exceeding monthly tour-booking and application completion targets

• Proactively identifying bottlenecks in the lead-to-lease pipeline and suggesting process

improvements

• Managing a full pipeline of prospects from first contact through move-in with minimal

supervision




Work Environment

• Hybrid position – Work from home with reliable internet and a quiet workspace

• Core working hours required – Leads come in during business hours and evenings;

schedule flexibility within coverage windows

• High call volume – Expect to make 40-80+ calls per day depending on lead flow

• Metrics-driven culture – You'll be measured on activity (calls, contact rate) and outcomes

(tours booked, applications completed)




Why This Role Matters

You are the engine of our occupancy. Every tour booked is a potential resident, and every

resident means a thriving property. But tours alone don't fill units—your ability to shepherd

prospects through the application process and across the finish line is what turns interest into

signed leases. Your ability to move fast, connect authentically, stay organized, and close with

confidence directly impacts the success of our portfolio. If you love the thrill of high-volume

sales, take pride in flawless execution, and want to be a linchpin in a growing operation, this is

your role.

title: customer service
description:
About the job




Customer Service




UBICACIÓN

Celaya, Guanajuato, México — Presencial, tiempo completo




DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO




Alcansa es una empresa dedicada a la inyección de plástico para la industria automotriz, con clientes de talla internacional. Buscamos incorporar a un(a) Customer Service que se convierta en el punto de contacto entre Alcansa y nuestros clientes, garantizando el cumplimiento de sus requerimientos y sosteniendo relaciones comerciales sólidas y de largo plazo.




RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES




- Revisar y dar seguimiento a los requerimientos específicos de cada cliente (CSR).

- Dar seguimiento al cumplimiento de entregas (OTD) conforme a los programas de embarque.

- Liderar la elaboración y cierre de reportes 8D derivados de reclamos de cliente.

- Dar seguimiento a no conformidades y consolidar reportes de KPIs para el área.

- Revisar y dar seguimiento a scorecards de cliente, elaborando planes de acción cuando se requiera.

- Gestionar requerimientos especiales del cliente (cambios de empaque, etiquetado, logística o ingeniería).

- Dar seguimiento administrativo a reparaciones de molde y a la vida útil de herramentales (Tooling Lifetime).

- Elaborar reportes generales ante incidentes con cliente, incluyendo paros de línea o embarques especiales.

- Servir como enlace entre el cliente y las áreas internas de Calidad, Producción y Proyectos.




REQUISITOS




- 3 años de experiencia en Customer Service dentro de la industria automotriz (proveedores Tier 1 o Tier 2).

- Experiencia comprobable gestionando reclamos de cliente y reportes 8D de forma autónoma.

- Conocimiento de IATF 16949 aplicado a atención a cliente.

- Manejo de portales de cliente 

- Nivel de inglés intermedio, tanto escrito como verbal.

- Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio (tablas dinámicas, reportes).

- Disponibilidad para laborar de forma presencial en Celaya, Guanajuato.




SE VALORA ADICIONALMENTE

- Familiaridad con procesos de manufactura por inyección de plástico.




QUÉ OFRECE ALCANSA




- Incorporación a una empresa establecida en el sector automotriz, con proyectos vigentes de clientes reconocidos internacionalmente.

- Un rol con visibilidad directa ante Dirección y con impacto real en la relación comercial con el cliente.

- Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo, con oportunidad de crecimiento dentro de la organización.




Las personas interesadas que cumplan con el perfil pueden postularse a través de esta publicación.

description:
About the job

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

The CX Operations Analyst will play a key role in building the foundation of Customer Experience analytics at Crunchyroll. This position will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing operational dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into contact center performance, customer health, and emerging trends.

Initially, the role will focus heavily on Tableau and Salesforce reporting, supporting stakeholders across Customer Experience, Operations, Product, and Business teams. Over time, this position will evolve into a broader CX Analytics role with opportunities to perform advanced analysis, identify drivers of customer behavior, uncover root causes of customer friction, and influence strategic business decisions.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems with data and wants to grow from reporting and visualization into advanced analytics and customer insights.

What You'll Do

Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, develop, and maintain Tableau dashboards that provide real-time and historical visibility into contact center operations and customer experience performance.
Build and support Salesforce dashboards and reports used by CX leadership and operational teams.
Create scalable reporting solutions that deliver consistent, trusted metrics across the organization.
Monitor dashboard performance, data quality, and reporting reliability.


CX Operations Insights


Analyze customer support performance metrics including contact volume, service levels, response times, customer satisfaction, resolution rates, and agent productivity.
Identify trends, anomalies, and operational opportunities that improve customer outcomes and efficiency.
Partner with CX leaders to define KPIs and establish measurement frameworks.
Translate complex data into clear business recommendations and executive-ready visualizations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, Data, and Business Intelligence teams to improve access to customer data and insights.
Gather stakeholder requirements and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Support recurring business reviews with reporting, insights, and recommendations.


Future Growth into Advanced Analytics


Develop deeper analytical capabilities around customer behavior, retention, support effectiveness, and customer journey optimization.
Perform root cause analysis to identify drivers of customer issues and support demand.
Contribute to predictive and prescriptive analytics initiatives as the CX Analytics function evolves.
Help build a culture of data-driven decision making across Customer Experience.


Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operations analysis, customer experience, or related roles.
Experience building dashboards and reports in Tableau.
Experience working with Salesforce reporting and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational datasets.
Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting customer service, contact center, or customer experience organizations.
Experience with customer support platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, or similar systems.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and modern analytics ecosystems.
Experience performing statistical analysis, experimentation, forecasting, or customer behavior analysis.
Knowledge of Python, R, or other analytical programming languages.
Experience working with large-scale customer datasets.


What Makes Someone Successful In This Role


You are naturally curious and enjoy digging beneath the surface to understand why things happen.
You balance technical expertise with business understanding.
You can build trusted reporting while also uncovering meaningful insights.
You are comfortable moving between operational details and strategic questions.
You are excited by the opportunity to grow from dashboard development into advanced customer analytics.


Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate, and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy great benefits and perks

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value


Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. 
Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. 
Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. 


Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:
About the job

At Paystand, we’re not just another fintech company—we’re trailblazers in decentralized finance (DeFi), transforming how businesses manage their finances. With thriving hubs in Santa Cruz, San Francisco, Austin, Minneapolis, Mexico City, Hermosillo, and Guadalajara, we’re leading a global revolution in financial systems. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years, we’re among the fastest-growing companies reshaping the future of finance.

Our Expanding Ecosystem: Paystand isn’t just a company—it’s a growing global network. With the strategic acquisitions of Teampay, a leader in spend management, and Yaydoo, a top AR and AP platform in Latin America, we’re building an expansive ecosystem designed to revolutionize financial operations and fuel business growth worldwide.

Why Paystand?

What We Do: By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, we digitize receivables, automate financial processes, reduce time-to-cash, lower transaction costs, and unlock new revenue streams for businesses.

Why We Do It: We’re driven by a mission to revolutionize digital payments and decentralize finance, creating a more open, inclusive, and transparent financial ecosystem, starting with B2B payments.

How We Do It: As change-makers in the DeFi movement, we don’t just follow trends—we set them. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of fintech and eager to redefine what financial technology should look like, Paystand is the place where you can make a significant impact.

Join Us: Be part of something bigger. Join Paystand and help us lead the financial revolution.

Role at a Glance

As an Account Executive, this role owns the full sales cycle for Paystand's CFO stack, engaging CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, and Treasury leaders at mid-size and enterprise companies. The role is responsible for creating and closing high-quality revenue opportunities by diagnosing finance pain, quantifying ROI, positioning automation value, and navigating complex buying processes.

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Roma Norte, Mexico City. The role is primarily conducted in Spanish, including day-to-day work and client interactions, but candidates must have advanced professional proficiency in English.

Responsibilities

The following are the primary responsibilities for this role. They may evolve as Paystand's sales strategy, AI-first operating model, and LatAm market priorities continue to mature.


Revenue Ownership & Full-Cycle Execution:
Own the full sales cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Manage inbound and outbound leads generated by SDRs, while proactively identifying and sourcing new business opportunities.
Build and maintain strong pipeline coverage through cold calls, email sequences, LinkedIn, Amplemarket, events, referrals, and targeted account-based outreach.


Consultative CFO-Level Selling:
Conduct high-quality discovery to understand finance pain points, ERP environment, cash flow needs, AR inefficiencies, decision criteria, and buying urgency before moving to demo.
Engage CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, Treasury leaders, and executive stakeholders with strong business acumen and executive presence.
Travel to client sites across the region as needed for in-person demos, executive presentations, relationship building, and negotiation sessions.


Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Value Creation:
Develop tailored commercial proposals, quantify ROI, lead negotiations, and close deals with a focus on long-term customer value and quality revenue.
Continuously improve deal strategy using win/loss analysis, pipeline data, manager coaching, market feedback, and customer insights.
AI-Native Sales Execution:
Use AI tools actively for account research, outreach personalization, call preparation, call analysis, meeting summaries, proposal drafting, objection handling, and deal coaching.
Create reusable AI prompts, templates, talk tracks, and workflows that increase sales productivity while preserving message quality and accuracy.

Requirements

Ideal experience for this role can be gained through professional experience, sales performance, educational background, certifications, or relevant projects.


Professional Background:
2+ years of experience as an Account Executive managing full sales cycles, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, ERP, digital payments, or financial management solutions.
Previous SDR, BDR, or similar sales experience is high valuable. Motivation, business acumen, sales judgment, and ownership matter as much as years of experience.


AI-Native Operating Experience:
Active use of AI tools for sales productivity is expected.
Candidates should be able to describe how they use AI to improve research, outreach, preparation, follow-up, and decision quality.
Market and Industry Knowledge:
Familiarity with financial operations in LatAm, including SAT in Mexico, ERP ecosystems, or finance automation, is a significant advantage.

What We Offer


💵 Competitive base salary + monthly commissions + accelerators.
📈 Stock options / equity participation.
✅ Benefits package above Mexican statutory requirements.
🏥 Major Medical Health Insurance.
🍽️ Complimentary meals provided at the office.
💻 Company provided equipment and tools.
🌎 Opportunity for advancement and growth in a rapidly expanding team.
👨🏻‍🏫 Mentorship, learning, and education programs.
💪🏻 Smart, high-achieving, motivated team that likes to have fun.
🎯 Mission-driven culture, where your work matters.


If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand.

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team.

More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. We are enthusiastic about providing you with opportunities to learn and grow within this role. If your experience aligns closely with what we're seeking, we encourage you to apply.

We celebrate the belief that diversity in backgrounds and thoughts fuels better problem-solving and fosters more creative thinking. Our commitment to adding new perspectives to the team reflects our dedication to innovation and inclusivity.

Your journey is important to us, and we look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team at Paystand. Feel free to reach out; we can't wait to hear from you.

Most of our roles are onsite. Positions that are eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements will be clearly indicated in the job posting.

For roles based in Mexico, only resumes submitted in English will be considered.

Agora is the global leader in real-time engagement, providing developers with simple, flexible, and powerful APIs to embed real-time conversational AI, voice, video, interactive live streaming, and chat into their applications and IoT devices. Headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, Agora is trusted by over 1,700 leading organizations across the globe to power best-in-class real-time experiences from social media and live shopping to education and telehealth.

Job Title: Customer Support Engineer (CSE)

About The Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Engineer (CSE) who is passionate about real-time communication and AI, especially Voice AI and real-time interactive technologies.

This role goes beyond traditional technical support. In addition to helping customers troubleshoot technical issues, you will also take a step up to guide customers on integration following the best practice and design the solution based on the use case. You will also have the opportunity to engage with local developer communities, share knowledge about emerging technologies, and help grow awareness of Agora’s Conversational AI capabilities.

If you are someone who loves troubleshooting technical issues, enjoys talking to developers, and gets excited about AI innovation, this role is for you.

Customer Technical Support

Technical Skills

What We’re Looking For

AI & LLM-Oriented Skills


 Strong interest in Large Language Models and modern AI application development
 Familiar with LLM application patterns, such as agents, prompt engineering, RAG.


Other Technical Skills


 Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, NAT, firewall)

 Ability to read logs, debug SDK/API integrations, and reproduce technical issues

Communication & Community Skills

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s B2B organization serves a diverse range of institutional and professional clients, supported by a growing ecosystem of sales tools and customer relationship management platforms. As our business continues to scale, we are seeking an experienced CRM Product Manager to define and drive the product strategy for the tools and workflows that enable our sales teams.

This role will own the CRM roadmap and prioritization across multiple B2B sales teams, partnering closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable product solutions. You will help establish a clear vision for how Salesforce and other sales technologies support Kraken’s go-to-market organization while creating greater consistency across platforms, processes, and data.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with practical Salesforce fluency. You are comfortable navigating competing stakeholder priorities, turning ambiguous requests into well-defined product requirements, and making thoughtful trade-offs across multiple teams and platforms. You understand how sales organizations operate and can distinguish between product, process, data, and technology challenges.

This is first and foremost a product and strategy role. You will have enough hands-on knowledge of CRM platforms to scope solutions, challenge assumptions, and occasionally unblock straightforward configuration needs, while partnering with administrators and engineers for implementation.

The opportunity


Own and evolve the CRM and sales tooling product strategy and roadmap across Kraken’s B2B sales organization, defining how Salesforce and other sales platforms should support different sales motions and customer segments

description:
About the job

About the Role




We are an international Tourism Marketing & Communications Agency dedicated to promoting some of the world’s most exciting travel destinations, airlines, hotels, car rental companies and tourism brands.

We are looking for a talented and highly creative Social Media Manager to join our digital marketing team in Mexico City and manage social media accounts for our tourism clients.




If you are a creative storyteller with a proven track record of growing and engaging social audiences, a strong understanding of the Mexican digital landscape, and experience creating impactful social media and video content, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.




Responsibilities: 

As our Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive organic and paid social media strategies for our clients. You will create and curate engaging content, manage social communities, oversee campaigns and help translate our clients’ brands and travel experiences into compelling stories for Mexican and Latin American audiences.




Your role will include:

Developing and implementing organic and paid social media strategies aligned with each client’s brand and business objectives
Creating, editing, producing, publishing and curating engaging social media content on an ongoing basis
Developing original copy, short-form video and other social-first content
Maintaining strong and consistent brand identities across social platforms
Managing editorial and social media content calendars
Setting and monitoring content marketing, audience growth and engagement KPIs
Planning and managing paid social media campaigns
Measuring, evaluating and reporting results, insights and trends to clients, partners and stakeholders
Proactively identifying content opportunities and emerging social media trends relevant to our clients
Making strategic recommendations to improve engagement, reach and overall campaign performance
Developing content distribution strategies to maximize organic and paid reach across appropriate channels
Working with graphic designers and other creative resources to develop high-quality visual content
Identifying and engaging with relevant influencers and content creators
Managing online communities and responding to followers in a timely and brand-appropriate manner
Staying current on social media trends, platform developments, digital technologies and evolving audience behaviors




Skills and Qualifications

We are looking for a creative and strategic thinker who can bring travel brands and destinations to life through compelling content.




The ideal candidate will have:

5+ years of professional experience in social media management, content creation and digital marketing across multiple platforms and audience segments
Experience working with travel, tourism, hospitality or lifestyle brands is highly desirable
Strong knowledge of the Mexican social media and digital landscape
Demonstrated experience with organic and paid social media campaigns
Excellent writing and communication skills in Spanish
Strong professional proficiency in English, as the role involves working with international clients and partners
Experience creating and producing social-first and short-form video content
Experience managing and providing creative direction to graphic designers
Familiarity with social media management and content management platforms such as Sprout Social or similar tools
Strong working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager and other major social media advertising platforms
Experience with platforms including Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
A passion for storytelling and the ability to adapt content to different brand voices and audiences
An analytical mindset and the ability to interpret performance data and optimize content accordingly
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts, deadlines and priorities
Creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach
A solid understanding of how content marketing, paid media, social media, influencer marketing, PR and email marketing work together to support broader business objectives




This is an exciting opportunity to work with international tourism brands and help shape how destinations and travel experiences are presented to audiences in Mexico and Latin America.




We are looking for someone who combines creativity with strategy,  someone who understands what makes great social content, but also understands that social media must ultimately support our clients’ marketing and business objectives.




Job Type: Part-time or Freelance

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Application: Apply via LinkedIn




Join us in inspiring travel, building tourism brands and connecting travelers with unforgettable experiences around the worldl.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you'll do

Responsibilities


Have the opportunity to join an operations team across Risk, Product Support, and Financial Crimes
Troubleshoot and solve complex problems
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams across the globe
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You are a recent graduate with less than 12 months of full-time working experience or a 2025 or 2026 graduate with full-time availability.
You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes. You are an organized self-starter with a passion for finding solutions to our users' challenges.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

description:
About the job

Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente Trilíngue – Espanhol-Inglês-Português 

Últimas notícias: A TTEC recebeu o prêmio “Best Workplaces 2022” do CompuTrabajo, um dos principais site de empregos do México.

O objetivo da TTEC é levar sorrisos... Ao seu rosto e aos rostos dos nossos clientes. Como Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente Trilíngue –Espanhol-Inglês-Português– trabalhando na Cidade do México, você fará parte da criação e entrega de experiências incríveis ao cliente, enquanto vive a experiência de trabalhar na TTEC, uma empresa com uma cultura corporativa e experiência profissional premiada.

O que você fará:

Você gosta de ajudar as pessoas? Nesta função, você trabalhará para resolver os problemas do cliente antes de encaminhá-los para o próximo nível. Seja buscando respostas rapidamente, consultando produtos com empatia ou resolvendo os problemas da melhor forma possível, você será a diferença entre a experiência do cliente ser simplesmente média ou extraordinária.

Em um dia típico, você:


 Responderá às comunicações recebidas dos clientes
 Realizará pesquisas para fornecer respostas para que os clientes resolvam seus problemas



Requisitos para a função:


 Nível de português, inglês e espanhol avançado, tanto escrito como falado
 Disponibilidade para trabalhar à noite e finais de semana
 Habilidade para navegar por vários sistemas da web simultaneamente (multitarefa)
 Competência no uso do Microsoft Windows
 Vive na Cidade do México ou em seus arredores, perfeito. Vive na área metropolitana? Está ótimo também.



O que oferecemos:


 Suporte ao seu desenvolvimento profissional e progressão de carreira
 Uma empresa com uma cultura inclusiva e dedicada à responsabilidade social
 Uma equipe global de pessoas interessadas em aprender e guiadas pelos valores da empresa
 E sim, com o salário competitivo, oportunidades de bônus de desempenho e benefícios que você certamente esperaria e talvez alguns que poderiam te surpreender



Um pouco mais sobre sua função: 

Estamos empenhados em garantir que você tenha as habilidades e o apoio necessários para ter sucesso em sua função ao longo de sua carreira. Desde seu primeiro dia de treinamento, passando pelo treinamento individualizado via webcam, engajamento e treinamento, até os 1000 cursos gratuitos para dar suporte ao desenvolvimento de sua carreira. E acreditamos que você já possua as qualidades necessárias e que não podem ser ensinadas: a predisposição e a empatia para ajudar os clientes. A comunidade TTEC está aqui para você como uma família dinâmica e global.

Você se reportará ao supervisor do departamento e contribuirá para o sucesso da experiência do cliente e para o sucesso geral da equipe.

Sobre a TTEC 

O objetivo da nossa empresa é a satisfação dos nossos clientes. É isso que fazemos. Desde 1982, temos ajudado as empresas a construírem experiências engajadoras, positivas e lucrativas para os consumidores por meio de nossa combinação de talentos humanos e tecnologia. Em nome de muitas das empresas mais renomadas e inovadoras do mundo, nos comunicamos com os clientes via telefone, SMS, chat e vídeo, todos os dias. Essas experiências incríveis começam com você.

A TTEC se orgulha de ser uma empregadora igualitária onde todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou status de veterano protegido. Nossa empresa adota e está comprometida em construir um quadro de colaboradores diversificado e inclusivo para respeitar e fortalecer as culturas e perspectivas de suas equipes globais. Fazemos grandes esforços para representar as regiões onde atuamos, não apenas fornecendo serviços e tecnologia de última geração, mas também sendo mais humanos. Fazemos questão de garantir que todos os nossos colaboradores se sintam valorizados, parte da empresa e confortáveis com suas personalidades autênticas no trabalho. Como uma empresa global, sabemos que a diversidade é o nosso ponto forte porque ela nos permite ver as coisas de diferentes pontos de vista e dá espaço para que cada pessoa apresente suas ideias únicas e inovadoras.

We look to aggressively deploy capital to grow the business and to enter attractive new verticals.

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.





What you’ll be doing:


Field & Team Orchestration








Regional Field Operations Support: Serve as the central operational hub for our remote Field Marketing Managers across the Americas region. Oversee the complete lifecycle of regional event collateral and swag inventory, optimizing supply chains and workflows to guarantee seamless, friction-free daily operations.








Procurement & Legal Liaison: Drive the end-to-end procurement process. You will coordinate with Legal, Finance, and Procurement to shepherd contracts through approval, manage invoicing, and ensure vendors are paid on time.








Budget Tracking: Assist in developing event cost estimates and maintaining real-time budget accuracy across multiple regional activations.









Event Execution & Logistics








Customer Experience Ownership: Own the end-to-end logistics for customer-centric events (dinners, roundtables, workshops) in tight collaboration with Customer Marketing and Account Management teams.








Multi-Format Support: Provide logistical backbone for a diverse portfolio of events, including roundtables, industry trade shows, and co-sponsored partner events.









Data & Feedback Loops








AI-Driven Efficiency: Actively seek ways to use AI and automation (e.g., within Slack, SFDC, or Sheets) to streamline reporting, draft communications, and simplify repetitive administrative workflows.












We’re looking for:





2+ Years Experience: Proven track record in Event Coordination, Field Marketing, or a similar high-volume Ops role.








Tech-Forward Mindset: You don't just use tools; you optimize them. High proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs/Sheets) and Salesforce is required. Experience with JIRA and Slack as project management tools is preferred.








Service-Oriented EQ: You have a proactive mindset. You are friendly, professional, and capable of engaging with everyone from executives to warehouse vendors.








Async Mastery: You are comfortable working across time zones with high autonomy. You communicate clearly and directly, defaulting to "showing your work" so the team can stay aligned.








Remote-First: Ability to operate independently across global time zones.








On-Site Support: Willingness to travel up to 10% to provide hands-on support for key events.













Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

description:
About the job

Founding LinkedIn Outbound Campaign Strategist

Hey! We’re Scale Up, and our client is looking to hire a LinkedIn Lead Generation Specialist for a fast-growing AI startup building an AI-powered growth platform for LinkedIn outbound.

Type of Employment: Full-Time Contractor (Long-term)

Work Modality: 100% Remote

Work Schedule: Full-Time

Location: Global

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing AI startup building technology that helps companies identify the right prospects, start highly relevant conversations, and turn those conversations into qualified sales meetings.

They are looking for someone who is exceptional at LinkedIn outbound. This is not a role for someone who simply uploads prospect lists and creates standard sequences. They need someone who can understand a business, identify the strongest reasons to reach out, define the right audience, create messaging that generates genuine responses, and continuously improve campaigns based on real performance data.

You will have significant ownership, managing campaigns from initial research and strategy through launch, testing, and ongoing optimization.

What You’ll Own


Learn each client’s product, market, customers, positioning, and sales process. 
Identify the strongest ICPs, buyer segments, triggers, and campaign angles. 
Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other data sources. 
Determine who to target, why they would care, and why the timing is relevant. 
Write connection requests, opening messages, follow-ups, and campaign variations. 
Build and launch LinkedIn outbound campaigns using the company’s platform. 
Monitor acceptance, reply, positive reply, meeting, attendance, and lead-quality rates. 
Identify where campaigns are underperforming and make the necessary adjustments. 
Run structured tests across audiences, offers, messaging, and CTAs. 
Review replies and conversations to understand what the market is actually saying. 
Pause weak campaigns quickly and scale the ones that work. 
Maintain clear campaign documentation covering tests, results, and learnings. 
Turn successful campaigns into repeatable playbooks for the broader team. 


What Exceptional Looks Like

You can look at a company and quickly answer:


Who is most likely to buy this? 
What signals suggest they may need it right now? 
Who should we exclude from the campaign? 
What would make the outreach feel specific without sounding automated? 
Is the problem the audience, offer, message, timing, or follow-up? 
What does the campaign data tell us to change next? 


You understand that great outbound is not about sending more messages. It is about creating the right conversation with the right person at the right time.

You May Be a Great Fit If


You have built and optimized successful B2B outbound campaigns. 
You are extremely strong in ICP research, segmentation, targeting, and outbound copywriting. 
You have deep hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. 
You can write messages that are concise, casual, relevant, and genuinely human. 
You understand the difference between getting a reply and generating a qualified sales opportunity. 
You are comfortable working across multiple industries and quickly learning new markets. 
You use campaign data to make decisions rather than relying only on intuition. 
You can diagnose targeting and messaging problems and act on them quickly. 
You take full ownership and are comfortable working with minimal supervision. 
You can clearly explain why a campaign worked, why it failed, and what should happen next. 
You care deeply about the quality and business impact of your work. 


Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, HeyReach, Expandi, Smartlead, Unipile, or similar outbound platforms is a plus, but results and strategic thinking matter more than the exact tool stack.

This Is Probably Not for You If


Your outbound strategy is mainly based on increasing volume. 
You rely heavily on generic templates with light personalization. 
You evaluate campaigns only through acceptance or overall reply rates. 
You need someone else to define the audience, angle, and offer. 
You launch campaigns and wait weeks before analyzing their performance. 
You cannot provide examples of campaigns you personally built and improved. 
Your messaging sounds like it was generated by a sales automation tool. 


How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be evaluated based on:


Quality and precision of targeting. 
Positive reply rate. 
Qualified meetings booked. 
Meeting attendance and lead quality. 
Speed and quality of campaign iteration. 
Client campaign performance over time. 
Strength of the insights and playbooks you produce. 


The focus is on qualified meetings, real sales opportunities, and revenue potential. Vanity metrics matter only when they help diagnose and improve campaign performance.

What Your First 90 Days Could Look Like

First 30 Days


Learn the product, customers, and existing campaign process. 
Audit current campaigns and identify the biggest performance opportunities. 
Take ownership of an initial group of campaigns. 
Establish a clear testing and reporting approach. 


By 60 Days


Independently research, build, launch, and optimize campaigns. 
Produce measurable improvements in targeting, messaging, or conversion rates. 
Turn early wins into repeatable campaign frameworks. 
Identify recurring process issues and propose improvements. 


By 90 Days


Own campaign strategy and execution with minimal oversight. 
Consistently generate qualified conversations through outbound campaigns. 
Raise the quality bar across the company’s campaigns. 
Help develop a world-class system for LinkedIn outbound. 


Why Join?


Work directly with the founder and have meaningful ownership from day one. 
Join a fast-growing startup where your work directly impacts customer results. 
Help shape both the campaign strategy and the AI-powered product behind it. 
Test strategies across different markets, offers, industries, and audiences. 
Play a key role in defining what world-class LinkedIn outbound looks like. 
Work remotely as part of an ambitious, highly autonomous team. 


Thanks!
